name: Lumen operational feature-availability groups

sources.supports: 303 records, four broad groups, vessel targets, source dataset. Current variable descriptions/units are blank.
Primary authors. Tables 1/2 verify listed age/weight/BMI/EF units and many abbreviation expansions; most lab units are absent.
Primary authors. Tables 1/2/3 identify demographic, symptom/examination and ECG group headings. Accessible XML contains these tables as images; individual image units were not inspected.

EF-TTE.status: explicit EF unit; mapping to EF-TTE column based on supplied feature name and echo group

caveats: Five groups are an operational experiment definition informed by source broad categories; separating laboratory and echo is our choice.
History includes demographic and recorded medical-history indicators. This grouping is not a validated clinical workflow or acquisition order.
Do not infer units from typical clinical use or development min/max values.
Original paper inconsistently expands CR as Creatine; retain source name pending stronger source verification.
Region RWMA is a recorded echo feature/code, not anatomical coordinates, a lesion location, or a source-verified abnormal-region count.
Original paper uses its own BMI-derived Obesity indicator; preserve the recorded category rather than recomputing a modern clinical definition.
Keep source category spelling Fmale in fitted encoding even if the display wording is explained.
Each feature-availability model must be separately fitted and evaluated within training folds. Nulling groups in a full-feature model is imputation sensitivity, not validated group availability.
Do not tune profiles or operating thresholds against final holdout labels. No final holdout data was read to define these groups.
A validation delta describes model evidence, not causal benefit, medical test utility, treatment effects or test cost.
